proposals.title: Repeated scarp-profile restoration against a drainage/shoreline null

layers.description: hs_lineament; dem_mean at 100 m, encoded by its pinned manifest

proposals.signature: On independent along-strike swaths, fit smooth-landform-plus-signed-step versus no-step profiles; score restoration on held-out profile samples and require a repeatable step away from channel corridors. Use the manifest to decode topographic indices and mask invalid/saturated values.
proposals.off_catalogue_rationale: A weak or cover-softened offset repeated across an otherwise smooth piedmont could escape catalogue mapping while retaining a resolvable profile signal. No mapped trace seeds the surface. Sub-pixel scarps are not claimed detectable from this 100 m cache.
proposals.non_fault_mimic: Fluvial terrace risers and constant-elevation pluvial shoreline benches
proposals.difference_from_implemented: LSC/TDKL/VESS/SHORE use scarp responses, polarity, knickpoint or shoreline context; they do not fit a cross-validated landform-restoration likelihood. MMRX restores magnetic texture, not landform profiles.
proposals.expected_potential: First relative priority; moderate but highly uncertain; no numerical DTI projection
proposals.falsification: Reject if sign/step evidence disappears across adjacent withheld swaths, depends on drainage pixels, or is equally explained by contour-following shoreline/terrace controls.

proposals.title: Terrain-matched radiometric alteration-width asymmetry

layers.description: K; Th; U quantized indices, not calibrated concentration ratios

proposals.signature: Fit relative cross-strike decay widths of within-band, terrain-matched K/Th/U residual profiles on two flanks and test repeated width asymmetry alongside a local RTP depression. Quantized code values must not be divided and called physical K/Th concentrations.
proposals.off_catalogue_rationale: A covered permeable structure might alter one wall more broadly than the other despite no discrete scarp. This conditional spatial pattern does not identify an alteration mineral or prove fluid temperature.
proposals.non_fault_mimic: Differential weathering of adjacent rock units and K-rich transported alluvium
proposals.difference_from_implemented: KTH/MVRD compare enrichment/redox levels or edges; this tests relative fitted decay width, not another radiometric high or a magnetic marker shift.
proposals.expected_potential: Second priority; low-to-moderate, uncertain; no numerical DTI projection
proposals.implementation_cost: Medium; quantization and background fitting need care
proposals.falsification: Reject if a parent-material/terrain-matched null reproduces the width asymmetry or the apparent signal is quantization/saturation dependent.

proposals.title: Conductive basin-breach connectivity against a paleochannel null
proposals.signature: Compare narrow conductivity connectivity across independently inferred basin-boundary saddles with a smooth basin-fill null; require cross-boundary gravity discontinuity and test a terrain-aligned drainage explanation. Work on relative model fields, not a claim of resolved metre-scale conduits.
proposals.off_catalogue_rationale: A buried cross-basin structural connection may have no mapped surface trace. The target is a candidate fault-related pathway, never a directly detected geothermal vent.
proposals.non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted permeable alluvial paleochannels and saline groundwater plumes
proposals.difference_from_implemented: CTRA/DHTC use conductivity curvature and thermal conjunctions; this tests topology-preserving cross-basin connectivity against an explicit drainage null.
proposals.expected_potential: Third remaining priority; low, uncertain; no numerical DTI projection
proposals.implementation_cost: Medium-high; coarse-field resolution is a major limitation
proposals.falsification: Reject if basin-fill smoothness or drainage connectivity explains the bridge equally well, or no boundary-normal gravity change is present.
